name: fix76_camera_jitter
verifies: fix-76: the third-person camera is steady — no pops or jumps while walking, running, on slopes and step-ups, through town past posts and trunks, drawing and sheathing (also while running: the hero's pelvis does not dip, the run cycle keeps its phase), attack combos, sitting down and getting up, a bench use, aiming a bow; a conversation glides in and out; a talk without a conversation does not move the camera
steps: log -- walk and run on open ground
log -- draw and sheathe while running: no body dip, no phase restart, no camera dip
log -- draw and sheathe standing, attack combo, sit down and get up
log -- bow: draw, aim and walk while aiming
log -- talk to an NPC without a conversation (a dev copy has no topics): the camera stays put
log -- a real conversation: the dialog camera glides in from the player camera and back (no cuts)
log -- slope and step-ups: the Nordmar path (terrain_ledges, r29 waypoints 24-27)
log -- town: Faring lower town to the gate, past posts, trunks, NPCs and walls
log -- a bench: the use moves the hero onto its spot and turns him (blend, no cut), then he stands up
notes: Run in the editor (no exe needed). Each 'camprobe off' logs: frames, step (largest per-frame move of the camera relative to the hero in his yaw frame, scaled to 60 Hz, m), jump (largest second difference of that, m: a pop), yjerk (second difference of the camera height, m: bob, step-ups), rotjump (degrees), pelvisdip (pelvis below its median at the same run phase, m), phasejump (locomotion phase discontinuity, cycles), drift / yawdrift (camera move from the first frame, m / degrees). Thresholds are first estimates from the pure-model tests (CameraStabilityTests): before fix-76 a pole popped the boom by 1-2 m in one frame (jump ~1), a step-up moved the camera 0.3-0.6 m in about 5 frames (yjerk ~0.1), drawing while running restarted the run cycle (phasejump ~0.3-0.5, pelvisdip up to ~0.09), a talk without topics cut to a dialog shot and back (drift > 1 m). Re-tune a threshold only with the log line showing it is a real, wanted motion. The talk_nothing span uses a dev copy of Kent (no topics: Talk does nothing at all); the start-without-engaging path (topics but nothing to say) is covered by Myrtana.Tests DialogEngagedTests. Slope path coordinates: terrain_ledges.json.
